meta.title: 一个视频教会你剪映专业版底层架构
meta.title_en: The Underlying Architecture of JianYing Pro

scenes.title_en: Opening JianYing: Three Things to Remember
scenes.context: 打开剪映只需记住三点：模板套用直接出片、云空间多端同步、官方介绍新手不用管；点开始创作进入剪辑主界面，退出会实时保存为草稿。
sentences: 打开剪映，在这里我们只需要记住三个点。
Open JianYing and you only need to remember three things.
remember three points（记住三点）
左侧的模板套用是直接出片，适合完全零基础。
The template menu on the left makes videos in one step — perfect for complete beginners.
make videos in one step（直接出片）
剪辑途中如果退出了，剪映会实时保存，以草稿的形式储存到下方。
If you quit mid-edit, JianYing autosaves in real time and stores the project below as a draft.
autosave（实时保存）
scenes.speak: Open JianYing and you only need to remember three things. The template menu on the left makes videos in one step — perfect for complete beginners. If you quit mid-edit, JianYing autosaves in real time and stores the project below as a draft.

scenes.title_en: The Three Zones of the Editor
scenes.context: 剪辑界面分成三板块：最左侧效果栏（加视频/图片/文字/效果）、中间预览区（实时观看）、底部时间线（剪辑核心）。素材导入点加号或拖拽。
sentences: 界面主要分成三个板块：最左侧的是效果栏，中间是预览区，底部是时间线。
The editor splits into three zones: the effects panel on the left, the preview in the middle, and the timeline at the bottom.
the effects panel（效果栏）
底部是时间线，这是剪辑的核心区域，所有的素材都会在这里排列和剪辑。
The timeline at the bottom is the core — every clip gets arranged and cut here.
the core area（核心区域）
新手最需要搞懂的是左侧效果栏，因为所有要剪辑的东西都得先从这里加进去。
Beginners should master the effects panel first, since everything you edit must be added from here.
start here（从这里加进去）
scenes.speak: The editor splits into three zones: the effects panel on the left, the preview in the middle, and the timeline at the bottom. The timeline at the bottom is the core — every clip gets arranged and cut here. Beginners should master the effects panel first, since everything you edit must be added from here.

scenes.context: 素材导入点加号选文件或直接拖拽，不需要按delete删除；素材管理有账号收藏、AI素材、官方素材库。音频有视频提取、链接下载、收藏音乐、AI音乐、音乐库和音效。
sentences: 导入素材可以直接点这个加号，选中你需要的文件然后点击导入。
To import clips, tap the plus sign, pick the files you need, then hit import.
tap the plus sign（点加号）
AI素材，在这里只需要以文字的形式输入你的想法，就可以生成图片或视频素材。
AI clips: just type your idea as text and it generates image or video assets for you.
AI clips（AI素材）
第一种可以从视频素材中提取音乐，点击音频提取，就可以得到一个没有画面只有音频的素材。
The first way: extract music from a video clip — tap audio extract and you get a sound-only asset.
extract audio（提取音频）
paraphrase: Drag and drop straight onto the timeline.
Your favorited songs follow you here.
scenes.speak: To import clips, tap the plus sign, pick the files you need, then hit import. AI clips: just type your idea as text and it generates image or video assets for you. The first way to get audio: extract music from a video clip — tap audio extract and you get a sound-only asset.

scenes.context: 文本类目有五个常用功能：新建文本、智能包装、花字库、文字模板、智能文本（识别字幕/识别歌词/文稿匹配）。AI可能有错别字要自查。
sentences: 第一个新建文本，点击这个加号，监视器里就会出现默认文本框。
First, new text — tap the plus and a default text box appears in the monitor.
a text box（文本框）
智能包装，它会根据你的画面信息自动给你匹配动画效果和贴纸。
Smart packaging reads your footage and auto-matches animations and stickers to it.
smart packaging（智能包装）
只要视频素材里有人讲话，点击识别就会自动生成字幕，就不需要自己打字。
As long as someone speaks in the footage, one tap on recognize auto-generates subtitles — no typing needed.
auto-generate subtitles（自动生成字幕）
paraphrase: It lines the script up to the timeline.
Give the AI output a proofread.
scenes.speak: First, new text — tap the plus and a default text box appears in the monitor. Smart packaging reads your footage and auto-matches animations and stickers to it. As long as someone speaks in the footage, one tap on recognize auto-generates subtitles — no typing needed.

scenes.context: 贴纸库是主题装饰元素、图形库做结构图；画面特效管环境、人物特效管人；转场拖到两片段之间调时长。
sentences: 贴纸功能主要有两个类目：贴纸库和图形库。
Stickers come in two categories: the sticker library and the shape library.
the shape library（图形库）
画面特效管环境，人物特效管人。
Screen effects treat the scene; people effects treat the person.
screen vs people effects（画面特效vs人物特效）
选一个转场效果拖到两个片段之间，然后时长还可以自己调，只需要拖动效果边缘就可以。
Pick a transition and drag it between two clips — then drag its edge to fine-tune the duration.
drag its edge（拖边缘）
scenes.speak: Stickers come in two categories: the sticker library and the shape library. Screen effects treat the scene; people effects treat the person. Pick a transition and drag it between two clips — then drag its edge to fine-tune the duration.

scenes.context: 滤镜一键套预设色彩；调节=调色（基础/HSL曲线/色轮），调节管整条时间线、调整管单个片段；模板拖入替换素材，数字人做虚拟口播。结语：上手才记住。
sentences: 滤镜其实就是一键给画面套上预设好的色彩风格。
A filter is simply one tap that applies a preset color style to the picture.
a preset color style（预设色彩风格）
调节是可以针对整条时间线，而调整是对单个片段。
The adjust tool works on the whole timeline, while tweak works on a single clip.
whole timeline vs single clip（整条时间线vs单个片段）
模板就是剪映已经帮你做好的成品框架。
Templates are finished frames JianYing has already built for you.
finished frames（成品框架）
眼睛看过不一定能记住，上手了才容易记住。
Watching with your eyes isn't remembering — hands-on is what sticks.
hands-on（上手）
scenes.speak: A filter is simply one tap that applies a preset color style to the picture. The adjust tool works on the whole timeline, while tweak works on a single clip. Templates are finished frames JianYing has already built for you. Watching with your eyes isn't remembering — hands-on is what sticks.

practice.q: 「调节 vs 调整」区别怎么表达？
practice.a: Adjust works on the whole timeline; tweak on a single clip.

pitfalls: Try to memorize every button on the opening screen.
Remember three points, then tap Create at the top.
The rest is noise for beginners — the real editor starts with Create.
Add every clip and never clean up.
Hit delete for anything you don't use.
A messy timeline is the top beginner trap.
AI can misspell; a quick pass fixes it.
Watch the tutorial and never open the app.
Run through all nine tools hands-on.
shifts: 打开剪映一脸懵，功能太多记不住
三板块+效果栏链路，上手一遍就内化
difficult_words: Add everything from the effects panel.
The preview shows your result live.
The timeline is the core area.
Templates make videos in one step.
Tap the plus to import clips.
Drag and drop onto the timeline.
Type text to create AI clips.
footer_notes: 原视频为剪映专业版入门教程口播（作者：自游摄影频道），转录为繁体已转简体，英文为场景意译，适合跟读学习剪辑表达；ASR 术语已按语境校正（检映/简硬/剪影/剪印→剪映、提起→提取、虚浅→丰富、热耕语录→热梗语录、中意→综艺、字幕调→字幕条、校程→教程、色彩利菌→色彩分离、预示好→预设好、自立音调节→素材上方调节、履行→旅行、空格间→空格键、曲线→齐全、群序→趣味、摄轮→色轮）。
